_about.models_root: The folder your model folders live in. It is matched against the brands' modelsRoot in ~/.nexus-local/accounts.json to find the brand; accounts.json is written by the Content Board app, never by this skill.
_about.content_folder: The footage folder of a project: inside each project folder in a brand with itemLayout 2, inside each model folder in a brand with itemLayout 1. A brand's own contentFolder in accounts.json wins over it.
_about.ideas_and_tutorials: idea.ideas_folder and idea.tutorials_folder are legacy only: used for a brand with itemLayout 1 (the older format). A brand with itemLayout 2 keeps ideas and tutorials as project folders in its content root and never reads them.
